klra.intro: Where critical knowledge is about to walk out. Each position gets an attrition factor and a position factor (1 to 5); total = attrition x position. High-risk positions need a mitigation plan before the quarter closes.
klra.noAccess: No access to the knowledge loss risk assessment
klra.noAccessBody: It is open to the knowledge-management owner, department heads for their scope and HR as aggregates.
klra.aggBody: HR sees the department heatmap; individual positions stay with the knowledge-management owner and department heads.
klra.scopeNote: You see the positions in your scope as department head. The knowledge-management owner sees every position.
klra.bandsOnly: Retirement and contract information shows as bands only. No birth date, age or exact date is held or shown.
klra.pendingTitle: {n} positions not yet assessed this quarter
klra.pendingBody: Assess them one by one, or (knowledge-management owner) assess all of them with the proposed factors.
klra.reassessTitle: Assess the rest of the quarter
klra.reassessBody: {n} positions are assessed for {period} with their proposed factors. You can adjust any of them afterwards.
klra.matrixCaption: Number of positions by attrition factor and position factor
klra.matrixHelp: Rows are the attrition factor (5 at the top), columns the position factor. The small number is the total; the colour is its band.
klra.cellPickBody: Choose a cell to list its positions
klra.excluded: Security, safeguards and cyber positions are out of scope (career path only).
klra.noteRequired: Why did you change the proposal? (required)
klra.afterQuarter: This is after the quarter closes; the row reads planned, but aim to finish within the quarter.
klra.positionNotFoundBody: It is outside your scope, or it is not in the register.
klra.neededBody: This high-risk position needs at least one mitigation action before the quarter closes.
klra.overdueBody: The quarter closed without a mitigation action for this high-risk position.
klra.doneBody: The action is closed as done.
klra.cancelBody: The action is cancelled. Give the reason.

method.title: How the assessment works
method.intro: Following the IAEA knowledge loss risk management approach, each position is rated on two factors from 1 (low) to 5 (high).
method.retire: Retirement window band (within 2 years = 5, 2 to 5 years = 3, later = 1)
method.contract: Contract or secondment end band (within 1 year = 5, 1 to 2 years = 4, 2 to 5 years = 2)
method.ossa: KHNP OSSA cover, which ends with the programme in 2030 (= 4)
method.crit: Criticality: critical role 5, regulated or leadership 4, qualified 3, other 2
method.uniq: Uniqueness: single points of failure in the team (2 or more = 5, one = 4, none = 1)
method.tacit: Tacit knowledge: how much is codified in standards, OE and published knowledge assets
method.repl: Difficulty to replace: months to qualify a successor (48+ = 5, 24+ = 4, 12+ = 3, 6+ = 2)
method.total: Total = attrition x position (1 to 25). The assessor confirms the proposal or adjusts it with a note; every row shows its reasons.
method.loop: Publishing a reviewed knowledge asset for a position codifies more of its know-how, so the next quarter's proposal can come down.
method.ownerNote: Changes apply to every row at once and are audited.
method.invalid: Use whole numbers: medium from 2, high up to 25, medium below high.
method.preview: With these thresholds, {n} positions this quarter would be high risk.
method.confirmBody: High from {high} and medium from {medium}. Every band is recalculated and the change is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.

editor.incomplete: Complete both languages, the body and the system family to submit.
editor.blockedBody: Capture the reasoning, lessons and rules of thumb. Leave out plant security arrangements, safeguards figures and cyber or network details; submission is blocked until they are removed.

review.intro: Every knowledge asset needs a technical review and a security and content check by two different people, neither the author nor the expert. The knowledge-management owner publishes.

review.checkDeid: De-identified: no names of people, no contact details
review.checkNoSec: No security, safeguards or cyber details

review.confirmChanges: The asset goes back to the author as a draft with your note.
review.confirmPublish: The asset is published to the knowledge base for all staff. The publication is recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger, and a linked KLRA capture action closes as done.

mine.howBody: A lecture you delivered (once published) and a knowledge asset you wrote or that captures your knowledge become contributions. They count only after the knowledge-management owner validates them: then each linked skill gets validated evidence (level 3 for a speaker or subject-matter expert, 2 for an author) and your skills are recomputed. Security and cyber-hygiene skills never carry this evidence.

ctb.intro: Publish lectures that experts submitted and validate contributions. Validated contributions become skill evidence; nothing is written before.
ctb.noAccess: Only the knowledge-management owner reviews lectures and contributions
ctb.ruleBody: You never decide your own lecture or contribution. Publishing re-screens the text and refuses security-restricted topics. Validation writes validated evidence on each linked skill (level 3 for a speaker or subject-matter expert, 2 for an author) and recomputes the person's skills; a rejection needs a reason and writes nothing.
ctb.syncHelp: Opens a contribution for every published lecture and knowledge asset that has none yet.
ctb.syncConsequence: Pending contributions are opened for published lectures and knowledge assets without one. Nothing is validated.
ctb.ownLecture: You cannot publish your own lecture
ctb.ownContribution: You cannot validate your own contribution
ctb.publishConsequence: "{title}" joins the lecture library for all staff and its speaker's contribution opens for validation. Recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
ctb.returnConsequence: The lecture is withdrawn with your reason; the speaker can record it again.
ctb.noCarry: Cannot carry evidence (security, cyber hygiene or obsolete)
ctb.sourceGone: The lecture or asset is no longer published: it can be rejected, not validated.
ctb.rejectReason: Reason for the contributor (at least 5 characters)
ctb.validateConsequence: {n} validated evidence rows at level {level} are written for {name} and their skills are recomputed. Recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger. Internal recognition, not a qualification.
ctb.rejectConsequence: The contributor sees your reason. No evidence is written.

lz.intro: Programmes and qualification steps that a partner still delivers or signs off, and when ENEC's own instructors take each one over, by the end of 2030 at the latest. Readiness is computed from the instructor pipeline, never typed in.
lz.noAccess: The localisation countdown is open to ENEC staff

sample.title: SAMPLE plan
sample.body: Items, partners and dates are an illustrative plan for this demo, not an ENEC or partner commitment. Instructor readiness comes from the synthetic instructor pipeline.

lz.overdueTitle: {n} items are past their target date
lz.overdueBoard: These items also appear on the Handover 2030 board.
lz.howTitle: How readiness and risk are computed

how.computed: Readiness counts ENEC's own instructor tracks that cover the item's qualification standards (or its discipline): it is computed every time, never stored.
how.weights: A qualified instructor whose annual currency has not lapsed counts fully; pipeline tracks count by stage (ready 0.8, solo 0.6, co-teach 0.4, initial training 0.2, nominated 0.1); lapsed, withdrawn and declined tracks count nothing.
how.risk: Risk is high below 50% readiness with 18 months or less to go (or below 80% with 6 months), medium below 80% with two years or less, below 50%, or on hold; past the target date it is overdue.
how.transfer: Only the training manager marks an item transferred, and only when enough current in-house instructors cover it.
how.protected: Nationality, gender and age are never read: the count is about ENEC's own instructors, not about who they are.

lz.noInstructors: No instructor track covers this item yet.
lz.editHelp: Readiness is computed and cannot be edited. A new target date, putting an item on hold or reopening a transferred item needs a reason.
lz.saveConsequence: Status becomes {status} with the target {date}. The change is kept in the item's history and recorded in the audit log and the NEXUS ledger.
